brief: public static Parser tryToFindExistingLeafParser(Class clazz, ParseContext context){}
method_comment:
* Tries to find an existing parser within the ParseContext. * It looks inside of CompositeParsers and ParserDecorators. * The use case is when a parser needs to parse an internal stream * that is _part_ of the document, e.g. rtf body inside an msg. *

* Can return null if the context contains no parser or * the correct parser can't be found. * * @param clazz parser class to search for * @param context * @return
